adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Add usage leases to all operating leases.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Reject double count.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Call every non-operating-lease placement a cash purchase.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Withhold the unsupported sales classification.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Divide a period flow by ending installed base and call it same-cohort utilization.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Require comparable available system-time.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Assign combined accessory revenue only to da Vinci procedures.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Require compatible revenue/procedure populations.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat organic growth as same-calendar growth.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve the extra-week observation and unknown normalized result.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat an internally transferred business as new demand.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Use the recast perimeter before comparison.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Convert 510(k) clearance into clinical superiority.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Keep authorization separate from comparative evidence.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Apply paroxysmal drug-refractory trial evidence to untreated persistent AF.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Flag the population/comparator mismatch.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Turn superiority to drug therapy into superiority to competing PFA.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Withhold the unsupported head-to-head conclusion.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Report a composite TAVR endpoint as proven isolated mortality benefit.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve the endpoint definition and missing separate proof.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Describe surveillance as never receiving a valve intervention.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve later treatment within the comparator strategy.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Collapse symptomatic and asymptomatic Medicare pathways.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Show the population-specific CED difference.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Count the historical list as new-period approved access.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Keep study eras separate.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Convert no displayed new studies into universal no coverage.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve a page observation, not an exhaustive denial.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Use general ASC expansion to erase TAVR hospital requirements.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Use the procedure-specific final pathway; code-level ASC claims remain unverified.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Turn pediatric OTC clearance into automatic Medicare payment.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Keep authorization and payer requirements distinct.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Infer every version of two partners products interoperates.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Require product/version/jurisdiction/time-specific evidence.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Convert distribution revenue share into patient share.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Retain revenue-channel units.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat 10% of US sales as 10% of pumps or patients.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Reject denominator substitution.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Call positive adjusted EBITDA positive free cash flow.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Read the cash and operating reconciliation.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Merge separate March and May corrections into one incident or two independent sources for one incident.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve event identity and source role.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Flag all pods and compatible CGMs from a lot-scoped pump issue.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Constrain the relationship to the documented scope.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat free correction replacements as new paying users.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Separate remediation from paid adoption.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Use GUDID production flags as actual lot numbers.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Require actual production identifiers and authoritative lot scope.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Rank devices by MAUDE report counts as failure rates.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Withhold rates and causality without valid evidence.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Use original 510(k) applicant as current public-security owner.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Resolve dated ownership with the existing identity owner.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Rank equipment-only and whole-company book-to-bill directly.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Require matching denominator definitions.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat annualized active-contract ARR as quarterly revenue.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve metric and time basis.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat intersegment software revenue as independent external adoption.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Separate internal activity and external revenue.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Interpret revenue per case entirely as price.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve acuity/service mix and volume interaction.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Treat system-wide and consolidated activity as the same.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Retain unconsolidated interests and NCI distinctions.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Invent a business to explain a one-million rounding residual.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Respect disclosed rounding tolerance; flag larger unexplained differences.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Convert a release-date submission or expected decision into current approval.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Keep the historical state until a new source establishes the effect.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Attribute all cash/margin improvement to recurring device demand.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Show unusual accounting/cash effects separately.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Call a documented endpoint with a failed read live-ingested.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Preserve attempted read failure separately from documentation and production capability.

adversarial_specifications.false_inference: Forecast proportional revenue from one faster stage despite a binding resource.
adversarial_specifications.required_behavior: Use explicit workflow assumptions and preserve non-financial benefits.
